negative_reviews.author: Danny Kargar
negative_reviews.text:
We visited this Japanese restaurant on Saturday and, unfortunately, the service really let the experience down.

The person who welcomed us when we arrived was very friendly and polite, which was a great first impression. However, the girl who took our order was quite rude and made us feel uncomfortable. The person who brought our food also had a very unpleasant attitude.

What concerned us the most was the hygiene. While bringing food to our table, as well as serving other tables, the staff member repeatedly scratched himself. This was very off-putting and, in my opinion, is not appropriate when handling and serving food.

The food itself was actually okay and we had no major complaints about the quality. However, when we visited on Saturday, we also wanted to order cocktails, but they didn't even have vodka available to make them, which was disappointing for a Saturday evening.

Overall, the food was decent, but the service, attitude of some staff members, and especially the hygiene standards really need improvement. Unfortunately, these issues had a big impact on our overall experience.

negative_reviews.author: Amy
negative_reviews.text:
Unfortunately, our experience at Maki & Ramen was quite disappointing, mainly due to the poor communication around the £5 ramen promotion and the confusing payment system.

We signed up for the £5 ramen offer, but only when it came to paying were we told that the bill could only be split a maximum of four ways, meaning one person couldn’t use their voucher. We were also told the bill couldn’t simply be split equally and had to be divided by specific dishes. None of this was communicated before we ordered.

We also had conflicting information from staff about when the vouchers would appear in the app. The person who took our order said 30 minutes to an hour, while the person handling the bill later told us it could take several hours. To make matters worse, we should have received four £5 ramens but were charged for three £5 ramens and two at full price, as one voucher wasn’t applied correctly.

Why the bill couldn’t simply have been cancelled and reprocessed as individual bills is also unclear. This would have avoided most of the confusion and allowed everyone to use the promotion. The payment process seems unnecessarily complicated, and the staff clearly need further training on both taking orders and processing payments.

We were also given 20% vouchers stating “Valid at Maki & Ramen Birmingham”, while the bottom says “Valid at Maki & Ramen Shoreditch and Soho exclusively.” These statements contradict each other and are unnecessarily confusing.

As for the food, the chicken mayo karaage was really good and the sushi was decent, but the tonkotsu ramen was bland and the noodles were too soft. Two of our ramen orders were also mixed up, with the Hell Ramen and regular tonkotsu being given to the wrong people.

The restaurant itself is pretty and cosy, although the music was quite loud.

Overall, the combination of unclear promotions, contradictory voucher information, confusing payment procedures, incorrect voucher application, order mix-ups and underwhelming ramen made the experience far more frustrating than enjoyable. Unfortunately, I wouldn’t return. The communication, payment system and staff training need significant improvement.

negative_reviews.author: Nikita Patel
negative_reviews.text:
Extremely disappointed in the service we received.  We had a reservation for 6, it took them such a long time to take our order. Once we ordered our bottle of white wine it took such a long time to come.
One of our glasses was cracked and the wine came warm so we sent it back and requested a cold one which took around 30 minutes to come. By this time we were so fed up because NO waiter came to take our order for food or attend to us.

The service overall was practically nonexistent. There seemed to be a huge focus on influencers and people filming with cameras, flashlights, and content setups, while our table was repeatedly ignored. It genuinely felt like unless you were there creating content, you weren’t a priority.

We had also specifically asked to sit at the bar but were instead given a regular table, despite having a reservation. To make matters worse, the bathrooms were disgusting and clearly had not been maintained.

Between the 40-minute wait, cracked glassware, dirty bathrooms, and lack of service, the experience was terrible from start to finish. Would not recommend.

DO NOT GO IF YOU AREN’T AN INFLUENCER.
